troubleshooting.fastLangdetect: 曼波报 "fast-langdetect: Cache directory not found" 时：把 site-packages\fast_langdetect\resources\lid.176.ftz 与 NOTICE.MD 复制到 GPT-SoVITS\GPT_SoVITS\pretrained_models\fast_langdetect\ 即可
troubleshooting.browserTabDrift: Playwright 页面会被意外导航到其他站点，导致 page.evaluate 报「Execution context was destroyed」。解法：用 page.context().pages() 找到目标 tab，bringToFront 后在该 page 对象上操作
troubleshooting.renderTemplateUnusable: render-template 锁定 1920×1080/10s 且缺中文字体，成片一律走 Playwright 逐帧方案
troubleshooting.uploadDirLimit: Playwright 上传只接受 profiles\desktop\.playwright-mcp\ 目录内的文件，需先复制成片

pipelineNote: HTML自包含 → Playwright 1080x1920 逐帧 __seek 截图（960帧）→ ffmpeg libx264 编码 → 曼波中文配音(GPT-SoVITS) → ffmpeg aac 混音 → creator.douyin.com 上传发布
